data.long_meaning: The Old Norse name Alda means old or ancestral. In Norse mythology, Alda was the name of the goddess of old age and wisdom. This name is rich in history and carries a sense of nobility and wisdom. The name Alda carries the meaning “Old, noble” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Alda usually hope their child will grow to embody old, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the wisdom and experience that comes with age.
data.etymology: Alda belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Old, noble.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alda total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
